## Environment

Describe the type of environment without exposing confidential information.

Examples: internal SOC, MSSP-supported SOC, hybrid SOC, cloud-native environment, financial services, enterprise, OT/ICS, lab.

## Starting point

What problem, maturity gap or operational challenge were you trying to address?

## UTIOM phases used

Which UTIOM phases or supporting concepts did you apply?

## What changed?

## Evidence and outcomes

What improved? Include measurable results where possible, while avoiding sensitive data.

## What did not work?

Share limitations, friction or assumptions that did not hold.
